notes:
- Fix: when Quotex dropped its connection at the moment of a click, the bot waited 6 s, saw no order and switched auto-trade off ("Quotex did not confirm the order within 6 s"). Seen live twice on 2026-09-29 (02:42 and 03:00, both at a reconnect in the same second as the click; Quotex's own order list has no order for either). Now, if the connection dropped around the click, the bot waits up to 15 s for the reconnect and Quotex's re-sent open orders: an order found there is tracked normally, a missing one is logged as "not placed" and skipped, and auto-trade stays on. Without a connection drop the old safety stop is unchanged.
- Log: "Broker socket open" is written once per reconnect (Quotex reports it twice). The signal-to-click line no longer claims a delay "after real time": the tick delay (feed.latencyMs) includes any PC clock difference (live: Quotex's order times run about 1.2 s behind this PC's clock), so it is shown on its own.
